executive_summary: BaraBand.se is a well-built Shopify e-commerce store selling premium European watch straps (Hirsch, Fluco, Colareb) to the Swedish market. The site scored 39/100 on the GEO audit, placing it in the Needs Attention tier. While the technical foundation is solid (SSR, HTTPS, Shopify CDN, mobile-first Dawn theme), the site is nearly invisible to AI search platforms due to critical gaps: zero customer reviews, no FAQ page, no llms.txt, no author attribution on blog content, and minimal brand authority signals outside its own domain. The gap between product quality and AI visibility is wide but closeable — implementing reviews, FAQ content with schema, and an llms.txt file could lift the score to 55-60 within 90 days.

findings.title: No Customer Reviews Anywhere
findings.description: Zero review infrastructure on the entire site. No Trustpilot, no on-site reviews, no aggregateRating schema. All four AI platforms deprioritize e-commerce sites without review data. ChatGPT Shopping, Google AIO, and Bing Copilot all require star ratings as primary trust signals.

findings.title: No FAQ Page
findings.description: Both /pages/faq and /pages/vanliga-fragor return 404. FAQs are the most reliably AI-cited content format. Queries like 'hur mater jag klockarmband?' and 'vilket armband passar Seiko 5?' are answered by AI systems from FAQ content.

findings.title: No AggregateRating Schema on Products
findings.description: Product pages use ProductGroup JSON-LD with variant-level Offers but are missing aggregateRating entirely. This blocks star ratings in Google SERPs, Google Shopping rich results, and ChatGPT Shopping eligibility.

findings.title: 500+ City Link Spam on Om Oss Page
findings.description: The contact/about page contains 500+ Swedish city/municipality links — a legacy local SEO tactic that confuses AI crawlers and dilutes entity understanding of the brand.

findings.title: No llms.txt File
findings.description: Returns 404. The emerging standard for signaling to AI crawlers what content is authoritative, what language the site operates in, and what sections to prioritize. 30-minute fix with high impact.

findings.title: No Author Attribution on Blog Content
findings.description: All 6 blog posts attributed to 'Jacob .' with no bio, credentials, or role title. Perplexity and Google E-E-A-T require named authors with expertise signals. Anonymous content receives minimal citation consideration.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList Schema on Product/Collection Pages
findings.description: Collection pages have zero JSON-LD. Product pages lack BreadcrumbList. No breadcrumb path display in Google SERPs and reduced structured data coverage for AI indexing.

findings.title: Blog Severely Underdeveloped
findings.description: 6 posts over 4 years (2021-2024), all under 200 words, no H2/H3 headers, no external citations. Zero citation potential for Perplexity or Google AIO.

findings.title: No Microsoft Merchant Center / Bing Webmaster Tools
findings.description: Bing Copilot Shopping requires a Microsoft Merchant Center feed. Bing Webmaster Tools submission improves crawl priority and Copilot citation eligibility.

findings.title: Organization Schema Missing Key Fields
findings.description: Current Organization schema has only name, url, logo, and one sameAs (Instagram). Missing description, contactPoint, areaServed, and additional social profiles.

findings.title: No GTINs on Products
findings.description: Microsoft and Google Merchant Center require GTINs for Shopping integration. Hirsch and Fluco products have manufacturer GTINs available from distributors.

Create llms.txt file and deploy to https://www.baraband.se/llms.txt

Remove 500+ city link spam from /pages/om-oss — replace with clean brand narrative
Add author bio page for Jacob with watch expertise credentials
Add Swedish company registration number (Org.nr) to footer
Add og:locale meta tag (sv_SE) to theme.liquid

Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to product.liquid and collection.liquid templates
Enhance Organization schema with description, areaServed, contactPoint, full sameAs
Publish material comparison guide (leather/rubber/nylon/mesh) — 1,000 words, named author
Register Trustpilot profile and begin collecting verified reviews
Install Microsoft Channel app on Shopify and submit Bing Merchant feed
Reformat Storleksguide as Q&A with H2 headings + add HowTo JSON-LD

Develop watch compatibility database ('which strap fits Seiko SKX013') — long-tail AI query capture

Create Hirsch, Fluco, and Colareb brand heritage pages — leverage existing ChatGPT brand knowledge
